limits: Privately rebuilt standalone primitive executables, not production DSOs or all historical split32 programs. Historical performance timings are not transferred to the patched binaries.
Seven small cases per parameter: raw permutation, SHAKE, uniform, eta at 17/65 requests, ExpandMask and SampleInBall; three comparison backends are retained.
Two shared-stream barriers are inserted in a private standalone harness; each parameter is rebuilt with the original flags and checked with racecheck/memcheck/synccheck. No performance claim.
150-second execution budget across private builds and nine tool processes; each owned instrumented child is limited to 30 seconds or remaining budget. Export/SSH transfer are additional.
Only the child process group created by this runner may be stopped at timeout; no other GPU process is stopped.
